title: Describing a Robot Once: One Text File With a Source for Every Number, and Two Models Made From It, the Built In One and the SDF

artifact.note: a robot description file in which every number carries its source or the word typical, a parser that refuses a number without one, the built in model's limits from it, and an SDF model (a body, two wheels, a caster and the differential drive plugin of Gazebo Sim) with inertias computed from the shapes
